title: Let consumers follow the latest compatible agenthouse release

fields.outcome: A consumer can opt into a moving latest release preference while every activated project runtime and frozen evaluation remains bound to an exact verified version and digest.
fields.scope: Add a consumer-owned update preference for a trusted latest channel, resolve it only at an explicit update check or between sessions, retain exact installed and rollback identities, and leave existing exact pins unchanged.
fields.acceptance: The preference is observable, reviewable, compatible with public, private, and offline-approved channels, and never turns latest into an unrecorded runtime dependency.
fields.decisions: ADR-0012 selects npm latest as the primary public discovery source with GitHub release fallback, verified integrity and provenance/attestations, release-declared compatibility, stable latest by default, and organization-defined channel overrides.
fields.verification: Exercise compatible update, no-update, unavailable-channel, tampered metadata, breaking-release, rollback, offline mirror, legacy exact-pin, and frozen-evaluation cases on supported platforms.
fields.dependencies: Implemented in the working tree; a subsequent signed/provenanced release is required before enrolled consumers can use it. Private/offline channels retain their existing approved trust contract.
fields.risks: A floating preference can weaken reproducibility or supply-chain trust if resolution is allowed during evaluation or if the resolved artifact identity is not retained.
fields.changes: Implemented exact/latest tracking, npm-first verified discovery, attested GitHub bundle fallback, release-declared compatibility, exact activation records, and future-release bundle attestation/upload. GitHub v0.1.9 remains intentionally ineligible because it has no bundle asset.
fields.evidence: Core tests cover fallback, exact tracking, compatibility, activation and CLI selection; live npm 0.1.9 verification found two registry signatures, SLSA provenance, SHA-512 integrity, and no invalid or missing audit attestations.

criteria.expectation: A consumer can explicitly select a stable latest-compatible update preference and can return to an exact version preference.
After resolution, the active runtime, dependencies, session record, and rollback state identify exact versions and content digests.
Latest resolution occurs only during an explicit update check or configured between-session update and never changes code during a running task.
Frozen and CI evaluation performs no update discovery or activation and continues to validate the recorded exact snapshot.
Untrusted, tampered, unavailable, incompatible, or breaking channel results do not replace the current usable runtime and produce an actionable non-success result.
An already-enrolled repository with an exact pin or no new update preference retains its current behavior without migration.
